title: Optimize cI24 structure and extract lattice parameter
action: Perform DFT geometry optimization of the cI24 structure at 16 TPa using a plane-wave DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO). Extract the optimized cubic lattice parameter a (in Å) and write it to the output file.
description: Whole-cell relaxation of the cI24 unit cell at a fixed pressure of 16 TPa, allowing both atomic positions and lattice parameters to relax.
output_schema: Single floating-point number representing the lattice parameter a in angstroms.

title: Optimize oP8 structure and obtain total energy
action: Perform DFT geometry optimization of the oP8 structure at 16 TPa to obtain its total energy and volume. Save the total energy per unit cell (in eV) and unit cell volume (in Å³) to an evidence file.
description: DFT relaxation analogous to step 1 for the oP8 phase, required for the enthalpy comparison.

title: Compute enthalpy difference between cI24 and oP8
action: Using the total energies and volumes from the optimized cI24 and oP8 structures, compute the enthalpy difference ΔH = H(cI24) − H(oP8) at 16 TPa per atom and write it to the output file.
description: Enthalpy H = E + PV. Use P = 16 TPa, the total energies and corresponding unit cell volumes. Express ΔH in eV/atom.
output_schema: Single floating-point number, enthalpy difference per atom in eV/atom. A negative value indicates cI24 is more stable.

title: Compute phonon dispersion of cI24 and get minimum frequency
action: Calculate the phonon dispersion of the optimized cI24 structure using the finite-displacement method with a phonon package (e.g., Phonopy) and DFT, and extract the minimum phonon frequency (in THz). Write the value to the output file.
description: Supercell phonon calculation over the Brillouin zone. The minimum frequency is the lowest eigenvalue of the dynamical matrix (most negative if imaginary modes exist).
output_schema: Single floating-point number, minimum phonon frequency in THz. A positive value indicates dynamical stability (no imaginary modes).

title: Compute electronic band gap of cI24
action: Compute the electronic band structure of the optimized cI24 structure using DFT with a suitable hybrid functional (e.g., HSE06) and determine the band gap (in eV). Write the gap to the output file.
description: The band gap is the energy difference between the conduction band minimum and the valence band maximum at the Fermi level.
output_schema: Single floating-point number, electronic band gap in eV. A value of 0.0 indicates metallic behavior.
